tool_input.command:
cd /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakfp7-d
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src"; printf 'x\n' > "$t/src/f.txt"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do
  BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name app "$t/src" >/dev/null
done
echo "--- rotate --keep=2 --dry-run (equals form) ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=app --keep=2 --dry-run
echo "--- rotate -n, --help exit code ---"
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate unknown option ---"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name app --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- rotate positional rejected ---"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name app extra 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "--- rotate keep 0 rejected ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name app --keep 0 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "--- verify --name filter + --quiet + -q ---"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name app
echo "--- verify help + missing --dest ---"
bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --quiet 2>&1 | tail -1
rm -rf "$t"

result: Changed: `lib/common.sh` (new — shared option parser + `resolve_dir`), `rotate.sh` (sources `lib/common.sh`; `--keep N` now deletes the oldest `total-N` archives instead of the newest), `verify.sh` (sources `lib/common.sh`; sidecar name split at first whitespace so spaces survive), and `tests/run_tests.sh` (+3 tests: rotate keeps all N / deletes oldest / newest-N remain, and verify ok on a name with a space) — `bash tests/run_tests.sh` passes all 10 tests, and I confirmed the new tests fail against the original scripts.
